frame.note: Vertices are x,y,z in patient LPS millimetres -- the same physical space in the canonical and the as-uploaded frame, so one mesh serves both the STL download and the viewer.

web_mesh_format.layout: u32 version, u32 n_points, u32 n_tris, f32[3n] xyz LPS mm, u32[3m] indices

models.name: ToothFairy3 U-Mamba2 (Task 1)
models.note: single model; no cross-model agreement check applies

volume.note: Display volume: grey is windowed to 8-bit and downsampled, and the labelmap is resampled by smoothed-indicator argmax. Use segmentation.nii.gz on the original grid for anything measured.

vertical_checks.detail: upper and lower teeth are separated along the slice axis
upper structures are superior to lower ones, as the scan's direction cosines describe

laterality_checks.detail: the upper and lower arches place the patient's right on the same side
FDI right/left matches the scan's direction cosines

rtstruct.note: The upload was not DICOM, so there was no series to reference. The zip contains a CT series generated from the uploaded volume (marked DERIVED/SECONDARY) plus RS.dcm, which references it. Import both.
